name: ad-os-baseline
description: Windows member server baseline metrics (CPU, memory, disks, services, event log, hardware identity). R158.50.7j (2026-10-08): operator 反馈 win_event_filterxml '找不到任何与指定的选择条件匹配的事件' 是误报. 真因 PS5.1 Get-WinEvent -FilterXml -ErrorAction Stop 在 0 命中抛 EventLogQueryException zh-CN message. fix 1.0.6: -ErrorAction Stop -> SilentlyContinue + 3 case 分支. case 1 (0 命中 idle) 不进 $lastErrorMessage, status=success 绿. case 3 (provider metadata/log 损坏/access denied/显式 throw) 进 $lastErrorMessage, status=partial 黄. 跟 ad_lockout_list 1.0.5 (R158.50.7h) + ad_eventlog_collector 1.0.6 (R158.50.7i) 同 idiom. R158.52 (1.0.5) hardening: $ErrorActionPreference Continue + accumulated $lastErrorMessage surfaced to centre as payload.error. R158.30 — hardware-identity fields: system_info (Win32_ComputerSystem manufacturer/model), serial_number inside bios_info (Win32_BIOS.SerialNumber), network_info (Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration IPEnabled IPv4 list with virtual-adapter skip filter), per-disk model+bus_type in disks[] (Get-PhysicalDisk), memory_modules (Win32_PhysicalMemory). C: drive used percentage renamed in front-end from '磁盘已使用' to 'C 盘已使用'. Schema is a superset of 1.0.3; ALTER migration idempotent via INFORMATION_SCHEMA / sys.columns guards.
